To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The future levels of medical manpower should be determined by a planning process that is based on a clear statement of the objectives of the provision and consumption of medical care services.

the planning of medical services should be based on the objectives of health care and that the planning of the medical manpower input should be part of a general planning process for the production of improvements in patient health status.

the planning of medical inputs, including manpower, should be done in a systematic way, with the objectives of the provision and consumption of health care services clearly identified, the production relationships between the services provided and the effects on health status determined and the values of variables influencing the production relationships identified.
In summary, our research is concerned with

defining the objectives of the provision and planning of medical manpower and with identifying the efficient mix of manpower and the efficient levels of other inputs in order to achieve the desired health status.

the identification of the most efficient production relationship between the inputs and outputs of the health care system, and the use of this relationship in the planning of medical and other manpower.
the development of a methodology to assist in medical manpower planning which is more realistic than that used in current planning exercises.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the future medical manpower planning process should be a part of an overall health planning process and should be based on a production function which includes a number of inputs and which is influenced by the consumption of certain other goods.
medical manpower planning is not possible without an understanding of the objectives of the production of health care and an appreciation of the production relationships involved.

the objectives of medical manpower planning should be to ensure that there will be the correct levels of different types (and types of) doctors to produce the desired health care services in the future.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the objectives of health care services are not clear and that the planning process is not comprehensive enough to ensure that the objectives are achieved.

the planning of medical services and medical manpower should be done as part of an overall health care services planning process and that the planning of future levels of medical manpower should be based on the identification of efficient input/output combinations and the recognition that the values of certain variables will change in the future.

we have shown that the objectives for medical manpower planning should be based on the desired health care outputs and the planning should be part of a wider planning process for improving health status.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the objectives for medical manpower planning should not be defined in isolation but should be part and parcel of an overall planning for improvements in health status, and that medical manpower planning should be done within an overall framework for planning health care services.
the production function for health care services should be recognised in medical manpower planning and the objectives for outputs should be clearly defined.

the objectives for the provision of health services should be defined in terms of improvements in patient health status and that the production of these services should be considered in an overall planning process.
